ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 85:15 ratio of high-intensity (white/light-yellow) to low-intensity (black/dark-grey) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity white field with large, irregular contiguous regions of mid-intensity yellow/ochre pigmentation concentrated in the lower-central and mid-left regions. Low-intensity black pixels form a continuous narrow band along the trailing edge and the peduncle insertion point.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with an obtuse internal angle of approximately 130 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Densely serrated trailing edge exhibiting high-frequency, low-amplitude pixel variations (peaks and valleys) along the entire boundary, with increased amplitude at the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges follow a convex sweep from the median notch to the tips; leading edges exhibit a slight concave curvature.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Numerous localized, roughly circular high-contrast pixel clusters (white and dark-centered) distributed across the mid-sections of both lobes, suggesting barnacle colonization or focal scarring.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, vertically-oriented linear pixel disruptions visible on the left lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive yellow-brown surface discoloration across the central-lower fluke area. Dense accumulation of small circular scars and bump-like textures across the entire ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced asymmetrical ochre-colored mottling localized primarily to the lower-central fluke and left mid-lobe.
